title: Roman Election Posters
sentences: Pompeii's walls are covered in 2,000-year-old campaign ads.
Professional sign painters wrote them in red and black paint, asking people to vote.
More than twenty-six hundred election notices are known.
Neighbors, trade groups, even fruit sellers backed their candidates by name.
Some ads were probably dirty tricks.
One says all the late drinkers want Marcus Cerrinius Vatia elected, likely painted by his rivals.
caption:
Pompeii's walls are covered in 2,000-year-old campaign ads, and some are dirty tricks.
